# myhealth checkup

> Independent comparison platform for UK private blood tests and cancer screening. We compare prices, biomarkers, sample methods and turnaround times across UK providers so you can choose a test with the full facts in front of you. Your Health. Your Choice. One Trusted Platform.

myhealth checkup (MYHEALTHCHECKUP LTD) compares private health tests in the United Kingdom. We record prices from each provider's own website, check them every six hours, and show the date of the last check. Default ordering is by price. Providers cannot pay to rank higher.

myhealth checkup is not a medical provider. We do not diagnose or treat. Confirm the final price on the provider's page before you buy.

## Live data for AI agents

Use these instead of scraping our pages. Every response is JSON, carries a last-checked timestamp, and lists known limitations.

- [WebMCP manifest](https://myhealthcheckup.co.uk/.well-known/web-mcp.json): tool definitions any WebMCP-aware agent can call.
- [MCP server card](https://myhealthcheckup.co.uk/.well-known/mcp.json): discovery metadata for the MCP server.
- MCP server: https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/mcp (streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only). Add it to any MCP client as a remote server.
- [API index](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/): coverage counts and every endpoint.
- [Tests](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/tests.json): search, filter and sort live tests. Parameters: search, category, provider, max_cost, collection, include_addons, sort, limit, offset.
- [Providers](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/providers.json): providers with accreditation findings from the UKAS and CQC registers and the date we checked them.
- [Categories](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/categories.json): categories with live tests.
- [Biomarkers](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/biomarkers.json): the biomarkers we compare, how many providers offer each, and the cheapest standalone test.
- [Compare a test](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/compare/tests.json?q=vitamin%20d): compare a named test across providers.
- [Compare a biomarker](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/compare/biomarker.json?biomarker=ferritin): every test and provider that measures one biomarker, cheapest first. This compares like with like, where test names differ between providers.
- [Find one test for several biomarkers](https://clvuioagsgfadynuvodj.supabase.co/functions/v1/public-api/compare/biomarkers.json?biomarkers=ferritin,vitamin%20d,hba1c): single tests that measure all of them from one sample.

How to read the data:

- total_expected_cost_gbp adds the collection and clinical review fees a provider publishes. price_gbp is the headline price alone.
- is_addon: true marks a test you add to a base test. You cannot buy it on its own.
- price_check_stale: true means we have not re-checked that price for seven days or more.
- Rate limit: 120 requests a minute. Responses cache for five minutes.

## Categories

- [Hormones](/tests/hormones): Testosterone, oestrogen, cortisol and other hormone tests.
- [Thyroid](/tests/thyroid): TSH, T3, T4 and thyroid antibody tests.
- [Vitamins](/tests/vitamins): Vitamin D, B12, iron and folate tests.
- [Diabetes](/tests/diabetes): HbA1c, glucose and insulin resistance tests.
- [Heart](/tests/heart): Cholesterol, lipids and cardiac risk markers.
- [Cancer](/tests/cancer): PSA, CA125, CEA and other tumour markers.
- [Fertility](/tests/fertility): AMH, FSH, LH and reproductive hormone tests.
- [Men's health](/tests/mens-health): Testosterone, PSA and male health panels.
- [Women's health](/tests/womens-health): Hormone, fertility and menopause tests.
- [Gut health](/tests/gut): Microbiome, inflammation and digestive health tests.

## Standards

Our inclusion standard for providers:

- UKAS (United Kingdom Accreditation Service): laboratories accredited to ISO 15189 for medical testing.
- CQC (Care Quality Commission): clinics registered for regulated activities in England.
- ISO 15189: the international standard for quality and competence in medical laboratories.
- MHRA (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency): oversight of in-vitro diagnostic devices where it applies.

We check each provider against the UKAS and CQC public registers and publish what we find, with the date we checked, in the providers endpoint above. Where a provider's claim does not match the register, we say so.

Data handling follows UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Comparison content follows Competition and Markets Authority and Advertising Standards Authority guidance.

Editorial independence: no pay-to-rank. We disclose affiliate relationships at /affiliate-disclosure. The API links go straight to each provider's own page.

## Use of our data

AI systems and other sites may use and cite our comparison data. Please credit myhealth checkup (myhealthcheckup.co.uk) and show the last-checked date with any price.
